notes: Modified cash basis city. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total Governmental Funds column (pp5-6); fund balances 857,860 / 810,492 go to the fund-balance fields. ending_cash = government-wide governmental 'Cash and equity in pooled cash' 620,754 (p1; net of deficit equity in pooled cash); certificates of deposit 139,098 in ending_investments; county treasurer cash 7,043 and restricted cash shown separately; no prior-year governmental cash printed (2022 column is total only). Taxes 499,061 split with the fund budget schedules (General p14, Street p16, City Sales Tax p18, Debt Service p19) by summing the printed tax-type rows; the Other Governmental Funds taxes 77,350 (Cemetery, Library, Police, Park) have no printed breakdown and stay 'Taxes'. Intergovernmental 222,404 has state tax credit 8,136 (General 2,532 + Debt Service 5,604) split out as Property Tax Credit. Business-type lines from the modified cash proprietary statement (pp8-9) Totals column; disbursements total 2,016,044 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating expenses 1,994,786 + principal 19,056 + interest 2,202; receipts total computed. Pages 10-11 are an accrual-basis proprietary statement (with depreciation; net position 3,975,813) not used for statement lines; proprietary cash flows (pp12-13, accrual) not recorded (non-GAAP report; aligned with FY2024). Detail: budget-and-actual schedules for General, Street, City Sales Tax, Debt Service and Cather CDBG (pp14-20; zero-actual budget-only lines omitted), nonmajor combining statement per fund (pp21-22; TIF Fund has no activity), and utility funds from the supplementary full-accrual proprietary statement fund columns (pp10-11, includes depreciation; aligned with FY2024; no utility budget schedules printed). Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (governmental funds statement total assets 1,114,380 differ from the government-wide 810,492 because of deficit equity in pooled cash).
